params._avatar: The Safe the module manages (executes as).
params._owner: Governance authority (e.g. a TimelockController) over the module's knobs.
params._paramsHash: The initial live PageRank params reference exposed for governance status.
params._scoreSnapshot: The score snapshot that pins params per checkpoint.
params._target: The contract the module calls (the Safe).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAvatar(address).details: Sets the avatar to a new avatar (`newAvatar`).

setTarget(address).details: Sets the target to a new target (`newTarget`).

params.checkpointId: The checkpoint whose inputs the proof consumes.
params.signers: The proven owner set, strictly ascending by address (canonical, unique).
params.targetThreshold: The proven Safe threshold (1 <= targetThreshold <= signers.length).

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

accumulator().notice: The chained-hash accumulator over the attestation log (source of checkpoints).

hasAppliedCheckpoint().notice: Whether any checkpoint has been applied (distinguishes "none" from "checkpoint 0").

lastAppliedCheckpoint().notice: The last checkpoint id whose proof was applied (monotonic).

paramsAuthority().notice: Narrow authority over only the shared PageRank commitment.

paramsHash().notice: Governance's live PageRank params reference for status and coordinated rotations.

paused().notice: A deliberate governance-controlled stop. Disabling the Safe module and pausing the         proof gate are separate, observable actions; either one stops owner rotation.

scoreSnapshot().notice: The score snapshot that pins the PageRank params hash for each checkpoint.

selectionParamsHash().notice: keccak256 of the selection parameters: `abi.encode(uint32 topN, uint32 minThreshold,         uint32 targetThresholdBps)`.

setAvatar(address).notice: Can only be called by the current owner.

setPaused(bool).notice: Stop or resume proof-authorized owner rotation through a delayed Safe action.

setTarget(address).notice: Can only be called by the current owner.

submitSignerProof(uint256,address[],uint.notice: Submit a proof that `signers` are the correct top-N selection for a checkpoint, and         rotate the Safe's owner set + threshold to match. Permissionless.

zkVerifier().notice: The proof verifier gating owner rotation (SP1 today; swappable behind IZkVerifier).
